# payload-attribute-access-assumes-dict

coverage_for accesses t.payload.get(...) without checking that payload is a dict-like object; if payload is None or not a mapping this will raise an AttributeError at runtime.

**Anchored to:**

- `knowledge_compiler/mcp/queries.py` — `knowledge_compiler.mcp.queries.coverage_for`
